messages.text:
Hi Georges,

Thank you for reaching out and following up on this. No, I have not received a replacement unit. I've been in extensive communication with Mike regarding this situation and have made it clear on multiple occasions that I am no longer interested in receiving a replacement and would instead like a full refund. Mike had mentioned that a replacement unit was already on its way to me. However, if it has not yet been shipped, can you please cancel the shipment and process my refund instead?

As you can imagine, after months of trying to resolve this issue, I would really prefer not to receive another unit only to have to ship it back again and go through the entire return process a second time. I appreciate you taking over this file, and I'm hoping we can finally bring this matter to a close with a full refund.

Please let me know what happens. Thank you for your help.

Marcus
Note to the team: I'll start by reading the skills and pulling the order.

Hi Marcus,

Thank you for laying it out so clearly, and I'm sorry this has dragged on for months.

Here is what our records show. Your Airsquitter came back to our Brampton warehouse on September 24 and it is with us. No replacement has been shipped to you, and no replacement order was ever created, so there is nothing in transit and nothing you would have to send back a second time. That part you do not need to worry about.

On the refund itself, that decision sits with Georges or Abel rather than with me, and I have put your request in front of them with the full history on this file. A colleague is picking it up today and will come back to you in this same thread with the amount and the timing. I am not going to quote you a figure before they confirm it, because you have had enough half answers on this already.

If anything changes on your side in the meantime, just reply here and it stays on the same file.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
